sentence: Es al·lot cerca sa clau p'es carrer.
ipa: əz əˈlːot ˈsɛrkə sə ˈklaw ˈpɛs kəˈre
gloss_en: The lad looks for the key along the street.
notes: Salat article ⟨es⟩ [əz] 'es al·lot' (Balearic definite from ipse) per veny1982; final-⟨r⟩ loss 'carrer' [kəˈre] and geminate ⟨l·l⟩ [lː] per recasens1996.

sentence: Sa casa és plena de gent.
ipa: sə ˈkaz ˈes ˈplɛnə ðə ˈʒɛnt
gloss_en: The house is full of people.
notes: Salat article ⟨sa⟩ [sa] per veny1982; voiced prepalatal ⟨g⟩ [ʒ] 'gent' and atonic ⟨a/e⟩→[ə] 'casa','plena' per recasens1996. Cross-word vowel contact per wheeler2005 §10.1: the final atonic [ə] of ⟨casa⟩ elides before ⟨és⟩, giving [ˈkaz ˈes].

sentence: Aquesta pera és seca com un os.
ipa: əˈkɛstə ˈpɛɾ ˈet ˈt͡sɛkə kum un ˈos
gloss_en: This pear is dry as a bone.
notes: Balearic open-mid stressed ⟨e⟩ [ˈpɛɾə] in isolation per veny1982; atonic final ⟨a⟩→[ə] and final ⟨os⟩ [ˈos] per recasens1996. Cross-word vowel contact per wheeler2005 §10.1: the final atonic [ə] of ⟨pera⟩ elides before ⟨és⟩, so the phrase is [ˈpɛɾ ˈes]. Balearic cross-word sibilant affrication (Majorcan regressive consonant assimilation) per veny1982 ch. 4, cross-checked against the 4catac expert Balearic annotation: the word-final postvocalic /s/ of ⟨és⟩ assimilates to the initial /s/ of ⟨seca⟩ and surfaces as [t], and that /s/ is affricated, giving [ˈet ˈt͡sɛkə]. The 4catac annotator writes the copula unstressed there ([ət t͡sə]); the stress on [ˈet] is a PRE-EXISTING divergence in how this spec treats the copula, unrelated to the assimilation and unchanged by it.

sentence: Es moix dorm damunt sa cadira.
ipa: əz ˈmɔʒ ˈðɔrm dəˈmun sə kəˈðiɾə
gloss_en: The cat sleeps on the chair.
notes: Salat article ⟨es⟩ [əz] 'es moix' per veny1982; voiced prepalatal ⟨ix⟩ [ʒ] 'moix' and open-mid [ˈmɔʒ],[ˈðɔrm] per recasens1996.

sentence: Ses cases velles tenen ses finestres grosses.
ipa: səs ˈkazəz ˈvɛʎəs ˈtənən səs fiˈnɛstɾəz ˈɣɾɔsəs
gloss_en: The old houses have big windows.
notes: Palatal lateral ⟨ll⟩ [ʎ] 'velles' and salat plural ⟨ses⟩ [sɛs] per veny1982; final ⟨s⟩ voiced [z] before vowel 'cases velles' (sandhi) per recasens1996.

sentence: On és sa clau des cotxe?
ipa: ˈon ˈet t͡sə ˈklaw ðəs ˈkɔtʃə
gloss_en: Where is the key of the car?
notes: Salat forms ⟨sa⟩,⟨des⟩ [sa],[ðɛs] (⟨de+es⟩ contraction) per veny1982; open-mid [ˈkotʃə] per recasens1996. Balearic cross-word sibilant affrication (Majorcan regressive consonant assimilation) per veny1982 ch. 4, cross-checked against the 4catac expert Balearic annotation: the word-final postvocalic /s/ of ⟨és⟩ assimilates to the initial /s/ of ⟨sa⟩ and surfaces as [t], and that /s/ is affricated, giving [ˈet t͡sə]. The 4catac annotator writes the copula unstressed there ([ət t͡sə]); the stress on [ˈet] is a PRE-EXISTING divergence in how this spec treats the copula, unrelated to the assimilation and unchanged by it.

sentence: Es meu germà viu prop de sa plaça.
ipa: əz ˈmɛw ʒəˈrma ˈviw ˈpɾob də sə ˈplasə
gloss_en: My brother lives near the square.
notes: Salat ⟨es⟩ [əz] and phonemic labiodental ⟨v⟩ [v] 'viu' (Balearic keeps /v/) per veny1982; final ⟨p⟩→[b] 'prob de' assimilation (sandhi) per recasens1996.

sentence: Sa reunió és demà a les tres.
ipa: sə rəwniˈo ˈez ðəˈma ə ləs ˈtɾəs
gloss_en: The meeting is tomorrow at three.
notes: Salat ⟨sa⟩ [sa] per veny1982; copula ⟨s⟩ voiced [z] 'és demà' and open-mid [ˈtɾɛs] per recasens1996.

sentence: Vine de d'allà i tanca es portal.
ipa: ˈvinə ðə ðəˈʎa j ˈtaŋk əs puˈrtal
gloss_en: Come over here and shut the front door.
notes: Palatal lateral ⟨ll⟩ [ʎ] 'd'allà' and salat ⟨es⟩ [əs] 'es portal' per veny1982; velar nasal [ŋ] 'tanca' per recasens1996. Cross-word vowel contact per wheeler2005 §10.1: the bare conjunction ⟨i⟩ glides to [j], and the final atonic [ə] of ⟨tanca⟩ elides before ⟨es⟩, giving [j ˈtaŋk əs].

sentence: Quinze taronges i dotze pomes valen deu euros.
ipa: ˈkinzə təˈɾɔɲʒəz i ˈðodzə ˈpoməz ˈvalən ˈdɛw ˈɛwɾus
gloss_en: Fifteen oranges and twelve apples cost ten euros.
notes: Palatal nasal ⟨ny⟩ [ɲ] 'taronges' and voiced ⟨tz/dz⟩ [dz] 'dotze' per recasens1996; phonemic ⟨v⟩ [v] 'valen' per veny1982.

sentence: Es ca corre per sa vora des torrent.
ipa: əs ˈka ˈkorə pər sə ˈvɔɾə ðəs tuˈrent
gloss_en: The dog runs along the bank of the stream.
notes: Salat ⟨es⟩,⟨sa⟩,⟨des⟩ per veny1982; phonemic ⟨v⟩ [v] 'vora', trill ⟨rr⟩ [r] 'corre','torrent' and open-mid [ˈkɔrə] per recasens1996.

sentence: Sa madona menja pa amb oli.
ipa: sə məˈðonə ˈmɛɲʒə ˈpa əm ˈoli
gloss_en: The mistress of the house eats bread with oil.
notes: Salat ⟨sa⟩ [sa] and lexical 'madona' per veny1982; palatal nasal ⟨nj⟩ [ɲ] 'menja' and open-mid [ˈɔli] per recasens1996.

sentence: Aquell al·lot jove fa feina a sa fàbrica.
ipa: əˈkəʎ əˈlːod ˈʒɔvə ˈfa ˈfəjn ə sə ˈfaβɾikə
gloss_en: That young lad works at the factory.
notes: Palatal lateral ⟨ll⟩ [ʎ] 'aquell', geminate ⟨l·l⟩ [lː] 'al·lot' and 'fa feina' idiom per veny1982; phonemic ⟨v⟩ [v] 'jove' per recasens1996. Cross-word vowel contact per wheeler2005 §10.1: the final atonic [ə] of ⟨feina⟩ elides before ⟨a⟩, giving [ˈfəjn ə].

sentence: No crec que faci sol aquesta setmana.
ipa: ˈno ˈkɾɛk kə ˈfasi ˈsol əˈkɛstə səˈtmanə
gloss_en: I do not think it will be sunny this week.
notes: Open-mid ⟨o⟩ [ˈsɔl] and stressed [ˈkɾɛk] per recasens1996; atonic ⟨a/e⟩→[ə] 'aquesta','setmana' per veny1982.

sentence: Sa muntanya és plena de neu enguany.
ipa: sə muˈntəɲ ˈes ˈplɛnə ðə ˈnɛw əˈnɡwaɲ
gloss_en: The mountain is full of snow this year.
notes: Salat ⟨sa⟩ [sa] per veny1982; palatal nasal ⟨ny⟩ [ɲ] 'muntanya','enguany' and open-mid [ˈplɛnə],[ˈnɛw] per recasens1996. Cross-word vowel contact per wheeler2005 §10.1: the final atonic [ə] of ⟨muntanya⟩ elides before ⟨és⟩, giving [muˈntəɲ ˈes].

sentence: Es nins petits juguen a sa plaça.
ipa: əz ˈnins pəˈtidz ˈʒuɣən ə sə ˈplasə
gloss_en: The little children play in the square.
notes: Salat ⟨es⟩,⟨sa⟩ per veny1982; final ⟨ts⟩ voiced [dz] 'petits' before vowel (sandhi) and atonic reduction per recasens1996.

sentence: Quanta gent ha vengut a sa festa?
ipa: ˈkwantə ˈʒɛnt ˈa vəˈnɡut ə sə ˈfɛstə
gloss_en: How many people have come to the party?
notes: Salat ⟨sa⟩ [sa] per veny1982; phonemic ⟨v⟩ [v] 'vengut' and voiced ⟨g⟩ [ʒ] 'gent' [ˈʒɛnt] per recasens1996.

sentence: Sent sa pluja caure damunt ses teulades.
ipa: ˈsɛn sə ˈpluʒə ˈkawɾə ðəˈmun səs təˈwlaðəs
gloss_en: I hear the rain falling on the roofs.
notes: Salat ⟨sa⟩,⟨ses⟩ per veny1982; voiced prepalatal ⟨j⟩ [ʒ] 'pluja' and final ⟨t⟩ loss 'sent' [ˈsɛn] per recasens1996.

sentence: Bon dia, com va sa vida per aquí?
ipa: ˈbon ˈdiə kum ˈva sə ˈviðə pər əˈki
gloss_en: Good morning, how is life around here?
notes: Salat ⟨sa⟩ [sa] per veny1982; phonemic ⟨v⟩ [v] 'va','vida' and open-mid [ˈbɔn],[ˈkɔm] per recasens1996.

sentence: Sa meva filla du un vestit vermell.
ipa: sə ˈmɛvə ˈfiʎə ˈðu wn vəˈstid vəˈrmɛʎ
gloss_en: My daughter is wearing a red dress.
notes: Salat ⟨sa⟩ [sa] and verb 'du' (dur) [ˈðu] with atonic final ⟨u⟩ per veny1982; palatal lateral ⟨ll⟩ [ʎ] 'filla','vermell' and phonemic ⟨v⟩ [v] 'vestit' per recasens1996. Cross-word vowel contact per wheeler2005 §10.1: ⟨un⟩ glides to [wn] after the vowel-final ⟨du⟩.
